title: Nolita Large Suede Bucket Tote Bag
description_html:
Nolita Large Suede Bucket Tote Bag by Michael Kors. Designed with superior craftsmanship and luxury finishing.

Product Specifications

  • Dimensions: 11.75”W X 12.5”H X 6.5”
  • Material: The leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance., Suede
  • Hardware: Antique gold-tone hardware
  • Lining: 100% polyester
  • Closure: Snap fastening
